verdict.rationale: Groq's docs describe only inference-serving of pre-made LoRA adapters uploaded by the user (groq-docs-11, groq-docs-20, groq-docs-32, groq-docs-36) — fine-tuning itself happens elsewhere; there is no evidence of an on-platform fine-tuning job, training pipeline, or dataset upload for training. Missing for 10: any fine-tuning/training capability, training API or job management, and evidence that the resulting model is trained (not just adapted) on Groq's own infrastructure.
